call.text: The decoder stack includes an additional sub‑layer that performs multi‑head attention over the encoder’s output, while the encoder stack consists only of self‑attention sub‑layers [AIAYN:3.1:c009]. In encoder‑decoder attention the queries come from the previous decoder layer and the keys and values come from the encoder’s output [AIAYN:3.2.3:c016]. Self‑attention in the encoder uses the same source for queries, keys and values—the output of the previous encoder layer [AIAYN:3.2.3:c016]. In the decoder, self‑attention is masked to prevent positions from attending to subsequent positions, preserving the auto‑regressive property [AIAYN:3.2.3:c016]. The retrieved passages do not state any further differences between encoder and decoder.
